memos.risk:
Risk call on Stryker: I'd refuse this one.

The curve shows bundle_share 1.0, completer_share 1.0, and 5 buyers, which is a bundled curve, not organic demand. Top-3 holders control 88% of supply. The 15-minute window looks busy (534 buyers, $170k volume), but net flow is only 19.66 SOL on 720 SOL bought, with nearly 700 SOL sold back. Post-graduation sell-to-buy is 0.54 and the top-5 buyers hold 55% of early flow. A launch bot was present. Those are the marks of a coin built to be exited into the buyers who arrive.

Pool depth of ~196 SOL is thin for a $20 ticket, so a round trip at 1.4-5.1% cost plus impact is realistic, and a 20-50% stop could slip past.

If the desk overrides this, the ceiling is $5, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold. But I'd skip it. Refuse any size if top-3 concentration stays above ~50%, if bundle share is high, or if sells keep pace with buys.
memos.scout:
The strongest honest case is the last 15 minutes: 534 buyers and 720 SOL of buy volume against 111 sellers, a 5.2% return, and net flow of +19.7 SOL. Price is still 4x its 30-minute-ago level, and drawdown from the high is only 20.6%, so the coin hasn't collapsed. The 2-minute post-graduation window isn't a factory dump either: no airdrop dump was seen and buyers were broad (105 ex-agent).

The case is weaker than it looks, though. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0, completer_share 1.0, and top3_share 0.88, meaning concentrated, coordinated early buying, and a launch bot was present. Sell-to-buy ratio of 0.54 in the first two minutes is heavy early selling. Recent flow is net positive but thin relative to a $253k cap, and a 20% pullback already happened. Demand looks real for now, but nothing in the brief shows it will persist for 30-60 minutes. I'd call this a marginal scout case, and the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost is material against a 5% recent return.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: insider distribution after a bundled launch. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0 and completer_share 1.0, with only 5 buyers pre-graduation and top3_share 0.88, so a handful of wallets controlled nearly all early supply. A launch bot was present and the first 2 minutes saw a 0.54 sell-to-buy ratio with top-5 buyers at 55% of volume. The coin is already 4.1x off its base and has drawn 20.6% off its 30-minute high, so insiders have had room to exit. Last 15 minutes show $170k volume with net flow of only +19.7 SOL against 700 SOL of sells, meaning the buying is churning, not accumulating. With a 1.4-5.1% round trip and a 195 SOL pool, a $20 entry needs a sustained move just to break even. Skip.
